summary: SK Telecom (NYSE: SKM) filed a Form 6-K disclosing the routine disposal of 51,952 treasury common shares between April 28 and May 13, 2026, at a weighted average price of approximately KRW 105,300 per share (aggregate ~KRW 5.47 billion). The shares were sold to officers and employees through broker SK Securities, with disposal prices equal to the market closing price on each disposal date. Post-disposal, the company held 1,732,142 treasury shares (0.81% of total shares). This is a standard employee share grant or equity compensation fulfillment, not a tender offer or special capital return event requiring activist or strategic classification.
